page.overview:
Who is Revney Grillante?

Revney Grillante is a character in Cars 2.

In Cars 2, Revney appears at the Wheel Well Motel when Mater calls into The Mel Dorado Show. At the end of the film, Revney is at Flo's V8 Cafe, listening to Mater's story with many other townsfolk and guests.
